jurisdictions.label: Abu Dhabi mainland
jurisdictions.authority: Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development
steps: Issue economic licence through official services
Attach lease or premises evidence when required
jurisdictions.notes: ADDED describes economic licences and permits, including standard, freelancer, virtual and dual licence categories. Bankable only routes and tracks the handoff.

jurisdictions.label: ADGM
jurisdictions.authority: Abu Dhabi Global Market Registration Authority
steps: Prepare business plan and application requirements
Choose ADGM legal entity and activity
Submit application through the ADGM Online Registry Solution
Receive registration and commercial licence when approved by ADGM
jurisdictions.notes: ADGM says the Registration Authority registers and licenses ADGM establishments. Bankable must not show automatic ADGM filing status without a provider event or user-reported reference.

jurisdictions.label: KEZAD
steps: Choose mainland or free zone jurisdiction
Choose licence type and legal type
Choose facilities such as offices, workstations, land, warehouse or build-to-suit
Submit registration and licensing application through KEZAD channels
Complete authority review and receive licence only when KEZAD confirms
jurisdictions.notes: KEZAD presents business setup, jurisdictions, licence types, legal types and business facilities. Bankable keeps KEZAD separate from mainland and ADGM.

personalServices.label: Freelancer Green Visa route
requirements: Bachelor's degree, specialised diploma or equivalent
AED 360,000 annual self-employment income for the previous two years or proof of financial solvency
personalServices.notes: ADRO states that nomination request submission for this category is currently unavailable through ADRO. Bankable can explain readiness factors and route to official sources, not submit for the user.

personalServices.label: Employee permits and residence Work Bundle
personalServices.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Ports Security
requirements: Integrated services from participating federal and local entities
Provider or employer reference needed for submitted or confirmed states
personalServices.notes: The ICP page describes Work Bundle services for hiring new employees, pre-renewing work permits and cancelling permits and residence.

personalServices.label: Abu Dhabi health insurance enrolment
requirements: Employer or sponsor arranges health insurance policy with insurer
Applies to non-UAE citizen residents and their families under Abu Dhabi health insurance rules
Policy issuance belongs to insurer or competent authority
personalServices.notes: Bankable tracks employer task and evidence reference only; it does not issue policies.

financeReferences.label: Mortgage readiness ratios
financeReferences.notes: Use for readiness factors such as deposit, debt burden and affordability. Do not display loan-approval probability.
